android.desc:
Heart Rate Monitor: Accurate Pulse Checker with Your Phone's Camera

Monitor your heart rate effortlessly with our Heart Rate Monitor app. Using just your phone's camera, you can measure your heart rate accurately anytime, anywhere. Whether you're at rest, exercising, or post-exercise, this app provides unlimited measurements and keeps a detailed log of your heartbeat data.

Key Features:

 Easy to Use: Simply place your fingertip on the camera, and get your heart rate in seconds.

 Unlimited Measurements:  Take as many heart rate measurements as you need without limitations.

 Detailed Records:  All heartbeat data is saved and categorized under "Rest," "Exercise," "Post Exercise," or "General" for easy tracking and health monitoring.

 Health Monitoring: Ideal for those who care about their health condition and 
 need to monitor their heart rate regularly. Provides reference to your fitness 
 level and overall cardiovascular health.

Exercise Intensity: Perfect for tracking workout intensity, including Running, Gym sessions, High Intensity Interval Training (HIIT), and Cardio. Displays heart rate zones like "Recovery," "Fat-Burning," "Target Heart Rate," and "High Intensity."

Why Use Our Heart Rate Monitor?

Fitness and Health: Monitor your heart rate to stay on top of your fitness and health goals. Studies show that a lower resting heart rate often indicates better cardiovascular health, reducing the risk of heart diseases such as heart attack, atrial fibrillation (Afib), stroke, and stress-related conditions.

Convenience: No need for additional devices. Measure your pulse anytime using your phone.

Accurate Results: Our advanced algorithms ensure accurate heart rate detection. Ensure your environment is well-lit for the best results.

Training Benefits: Get insights into your exercise intensity and optimize your workouts for better results.
How It Works:
      Start the App: Open the Heart Rate Monitor app on your phone.
      Place Your Finger:  Gently place the tip of your finger on the camera. 
      Make sure your hand is not cold.
      Ensure Proper Lighting:  Turn on the flash LED or ensure the environment is 
     well-lit. Avoid pressing too hard.
     Get Results: Your heart rate will be displayed within a few seconds.

[]record and display your heart rate history nicely with list and graphs.
It is based on my previous heart rate monitor application which has now 10K - 50k of downloads. Thanks to the comment and helps from redditors, I made a new application with the user interface redesigned.
This heart rate monitor are suitable for people who are care a lot of their health condition or in need to monitor their heart rate regularly. It can suggests you fitness level information. Recent studies shows a higher heart beat rate in rest mode may be link to a higher risk of heart diseases e.g heart attack. And the better shape you are, the slower your heart beat rate (but not extremely low) will be in rest mode.
It is also very suitable for people would like to measure their workout intensity. It is perfect for High Intensity Interval Training (HIIT). HR Monitor shows your exercise intensity level calculated based on your personalized maximum heart rate zone. And shows you which heart rate zone you are in - "Recovery Zone", "Fat-Burning Zone", "Target Heart Rate Zone" and the "High Intensity Zone".
